svg.text: One row per sample, coloured by each segment's mean log2 copy-number ratio (hg19, whole genome): white within ±0.1, deepening to red at +1.5 and blue at −1.5 and
beyond (IGV's segment scale, as the portal draws it); grey where no segment of the sample reaches. All 4 samples with segments are drawn. Rows: the patient's samples
in collection order (the numbers the patient's other views give them). Log ratios are not purity- or ploidy-corrected, and chromosome X reads low in male samples against
